headline: RSI4EO uses coding agents and sealed verifiers to build Earth-observation models
summary: An October 13 arXiv paper introduces RSI4EO, a benchmark and agent workflow in which GPT-6 Astra builds end-to-end Earth-observation model pipelines using a constrained coding harness and sealed task verifiers. The authors report that the agent exceeds published full-label baselines on four benchmarks, and that few-label runs retain 69–84% of full-label accuracy while using 0.2–1.4% of labels. The fifth benchmark lacks a same-protocol published comparator. These are paper-reported results: the linked project repository was empty when inspected, and no independent reproduction was run.
